newsitem.title: USA: Man adrift on jet ski for two days is rescued.
newsitem.headline: Man adrift on jet ski for two days is rescued.

text.p: A man adrift for nearly two days on a jet ski in chilly Lake Michigan was rescued on Tuesday, the U.S. Coast Guard said.
Ricardo Enamourado of Chicago was found sitting upright and conscious. He was taken to a hospital for treatment of dehydration and minor sunburn, Coast Guard officials said.

Enamourado had been missing since Sunday evening. He survived two nights in 62-degrees Fahrenheit 16.66C water before searchers spotted him about 500 yards (metres) offshore from Chicago's Montrose Harbour.
It was not clear if his craft ran out of fuel or had mechanical problems.
